symptoms.symptom: The appliance is not cooling, the displays and lighting are lit.

causes.label: Showroom mode is switched on.
remedies: Disconnect the appliance from the power supply.
Unplug the power plug or switch off the circuit breaker in the fuse box.
Reconnect the appliance after 5 minutes.
Wait at least 30 seconds and then press super (Refrigerator compartment) for
15 seconds.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 24: "Showroom mode is switched on."

causes.label: a     appears briefly on the control panel.
remedies: After a short time, check whether your appliance is cooling.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 24: "a     appears briefly on the control panel."

symptoms.symptom: The LED lighting does not work.

causes.label: Various causes are possible.
remedies: Call customer service.
→ "Customer Service", Page 28
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 24: "Various causes are possible."

symptoms.symptom: The refrigeration unit is switching on more frequently and for longer.

causes.label: The appliance has been opened frequently.
remedies: Do not open appliance door unnecessarily.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 24: "The appliance has been opened frequently."

causes.label: External ventilation openings are covered up.
remedies: Remove any obstructions from in front of the external ventilation openings.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 24: "External ventilation openings are covered up."

causes.label: Not a fault. Modern refrigeration machines switch on more frequently and have different power levels to cool more efficiently.
remedies: Remove any obstructions from in front of the external ventilation openings.
Install the appliance as far away as possible from heating elements, cookers and other heat sources. Avoid prolonged exposure of the appliance to direct sunlight.
Only open the appliance door as briefly as necessary.
Allow hot food and drinks to cool down first before storing in the appliance.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 24: "Not a fault. Modern refrigeration machines switch on more frequently and have different power levels to cool more efficiently."

symptoms.symptom: A layer of frost forms on the back wall of the refrigerator compartment.

causes.label: Not a fault. Modern refrigeration machines ensure a more even temperature in the refrigerator compartment. The back wall of the refrigerator compartment is defrosted automatically at regular intervals.
remedies: Only open the appliance door as briefly as necessary.
Pack the food airtight or cover it.
Allow hot food and drinks to cool down first before storing in the appliance.
Always leave some space between the food and the interior walls.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 24: "Not a fault. Modern refrigeration machines ensure a more even temperature in the refrigerator compartment. The back wall of the refrigerator compartment is defrosted automatically at regular intervals."

symptoms.symptom: Home Connect® is not working properly.

causes.label: Various causes are possible.
remedies: Go to www.home-connect.com.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 24: "Various causes are possible."

symptoms.symptom: "E" or "d" appears on the temperature display.

causes.label: The electronics have detected a fault.
remedies: Switch off the appliance. → Page 12
Disconnect the appliance from the power supply.
Unplug the power plug or switch off the circuit breaker in the fuse box.
Reconnect the appliance after 5 minutes.
If the message still appears on the display, call Customer Service.
→ "Customer Service", Page 28
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 24: "The electronics have detected a fault."

symptoms.symptom: A warning signal sounds and "alarm" flashes.

causes.label: The appliance door is open.
remedies: Close the appliance door.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 25: "The appliance door is open."

causes.label: been reached again. External ventilation openings are covered up.
remedies: Remove any obstructions from in front of the external ventilation openings.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 25: "been reached again. External ventilation openings are covered up."

causes.label: Large quantities of fresh food have been placed inside.
remedies: Switch on Super freezing before placing a larger amount of food in the appliance.
→ "Switching on Super freezing", Page 13
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 25: "Large quantities of fresh food have been placed inside."

symptoms.symptom: All temperature displays and "alarm" light up.

causes.label: A sensor is defective.
remedies: Call customer service.
→ "Customer Service", Page 28
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 25: "A sensor is defective."

symptoms.symptom: The temperature differs greatly from the setting.

causes.label: Various causes are possible.
remedies: Switch off the appliance. → Page 12
Switch the appliance back on after approximately 5 minutes. → Page 12
‒ If the temperature is too warm, check the temperature again after a couple of hours.
‒ If the temperature is too cold, check the temperature again on the following day.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 25: "Various causes are possible."

symptoms.symptom: Water is leaking out of the appliance.

causes.label: The water connection or water hose is not leak-tight.
remedies: Check if the water connections are fastened firmly and the water hose is undamaged.
If necessary, replace the water hose.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 25: "The water connection or water hose is not leak-tight."

causes.label: The drip tray is overflowing.
remedies: Clean the drip tray. → Page 20
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 25: "The drip tray is overflowing."

causes.label: Low water pressure.
remedies: Check the pressure of the water supply system or the external water filter system, e.g. reverse osmosis system.
Connect the appliance only to a water connection with sufficient water pressure.
→ Page 7
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 25: "Low water pressure."

causes.label: The water filter is blocked.
remedies: Change the water filter. → Page 17
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 25: "The water filter is blocked."

symptoms.symptom: Water is dripping from the ice and water dispenser.

causes.label: Air is in the water system.
remedies: Keep dispensing water until it contains no more air.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 25: "Air is in the water system."

causes.label: Ice residue is melting in the ice chute.
remedies: Remove the ice residue from the ice chute, for example using a wooden spoon.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 25: "Ice residue is melting in the ice chute."
